notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight artifacts.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 2 or less.
description:
Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Akiri and create at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Akiri from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the creature returned in step 7, and eturning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
